info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Langite Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Langite Notebook Detail Creation API enables users to add detailed information about Langite notebooks into the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to streamline the process of catalog management by facilitating the input of specifications, features, and other relevant data that enhance product visibility. Typical consumers include inventory managers and cataloging systems that require integration with external data sources. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that their product offerings are accurately represented and up-to-date within their sales platforms.

post.summary: Create details for a Langite notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create and initialize details for a Langite notebook. By providing the necessary information, users can effectively set up a notebook tailored to their requirements. Ensure that all fields are correctly populated for a successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the Langite notebook operation. It should include all relevant information required by the operation to process the request successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogLangiteNotebookDetailReques.title: Langite Notebook Operations Request Body

langite_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier of the Langite notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person who requested the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Langite notebooks requested for the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single Langite notebook.

CreateCatalogLangiteNotebookDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for operations on Langite notebooks.

CreateCatalogLangiteNotebookDetailRespon.title: Notebook Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the notebook record created or modified by the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the operation criteria.
